capabilities: Track combat encounters in an initiative tracker
Open the tracker from a ribbon icon in a sidebar view
Maintain two tables for Draw Steel style initiative
Add player characters in settings for automatic tracker inclusion
extras: Several features are only announced as coming later (negotiation tracker, montage test tracker, monster statblock CSS snippet), so current functionality is limited to the initiative tracker.
motivation: The README says it is designed to be used in conjunction with the TTRPG Draw Steel by MCDM, but gives no further motivation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for running Draw Steel combat, so Directors must track style-based initiative outside their notes.
summary: Combat encounter companion for the TTRPG Draw Steel, with a sidebar initiative tracker for Directors.
